title: Seek God First
opening: Seeking God first means letting His kingdom and righteousness guide our priorities while we responsibly attend to everyday needs.
points: Make time for Scripture and prayer before the day becomes crowded.
Choose honesty, compassion, and justice when making decisions.
Bring worries to God and take practical steps instead of being ruled by anxiety.
reflection: What change would help you put God’s values first today?
prayer: Father, order my priorities. Help me trust You, work responsibly, and seek Your kingdom in every part of my life. Amen.
